mostWorthwhile.text: Building the inner ear was most worthwhile: the bending hairs showed how movement changes signals sent to nerves.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the outer and inner ear felt mostly like an assembly step; the continuous cutaway was useful but added little explanation.

surprise.text: I hadn't realized that tiny hairs in the inner ear bend as fluid moves and change the signals passed to nerves.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The pictures explained the connections, though the compatible-options menu supplied the pairings rather than making me discover them.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: seeing how physical movement becomes a nerve signal was interesting, even if some assembly steps were predictable.
